requested_concepts.decision: Geometric motif; sequence screen plus one experimental structure representative; no universal geometry classifier or qualified occurrence.
Parallel paired-strand/helix topology; PROMOTIF documented, not executed.
Four-strand connectivity; partial topology extraction with manual review, not an automatic complete classifier.
Candidate mapping only: primary literature uses beta-beta for hairpins and unpaired arches. No exact synonym, new beta-beta ID or beta-arch ID created.
Paired antiparallel adjacent strands; connector is not necessarily a beta turn.
Separate compact four-residue geometry from DSSP hydrogen-bonded T state; repaired hierarchy preserves the distinction.
Existing umbrella identities retained; no universal detector invented.

requested_concepts.requested_concept: cavities, grooves, clefts, pockets and tunnels
requested_concepts.decision: Separate enclosed void, surface shapes and connecting passage; no shape-to-binding equivalence.
Functional subtypes need transport/ion evidence beyond computed path geometry; KcsA graph is study-specific.
Distinct site/coupling, modulation direction, covalency, conformational accessibility and interface context remain separate evidence requirements.

requested_concepts.requested_concept: protein binding, catalysis and metal coordination
requested_concepts.decision: Partner binding, catalytic contribution and metal coordination have distinct criteria; the two installed PDB representatives are not qualified occurrences.

records.identity_decision: Retain geometric two-helix/short-turn class under SUPER_SECONDARY_MOTIF; sequence HTH prediction and DNA-binding function are separate assertions.
gaps: Keep DNA-binding examples and predictions separate from the geometrical class. No generic geometry-complete HTH classifier was verified.

records.identity_decision: Retain paired parallel beta strands with intervening helix; E-H-E token alone is incomplete and Rossmann-fold membership is not class identity.
gaps: Read .bab output. E-H-E alone omits strand pairing/orientation. Remove Rossmann parenthesis from defining criterion; it is contextual, not class identity.

records.identity_decision: Retain four-strand +3,-1,-1 connectivity; several 3D realizations exist and an entire Greek-key domain is not one local motif.
gaps: Keep canonical token for compatibility; put connectivity in the STRUCTURAL definition. PROMOTIF .sht is an input for reviewed connectivity classification, not a verified automatic Greek-key call.

records.identity_decision: Retain adjacent antiparallel paired strands and connector; connector need not be a four-residue beta turn. Bare beta-beta is ambiguous.
gaps: Read .hpin output. In the existing token, turn denotes a connector, not a necessary four-residue beta turn; keep this explicit. Do not add bare beta-beta as exact synonym.

records.identity_decision: Retain compact four-residue turn with optional i-to-i+3 hydrogen bond; parent is POLYPEPTIDE_STRUCTURAL_MOTIF, not DSSP-specific TURN.
gaps: Read .bturns output. Move from DSSP-specific TURN to existing broader motif parent. Remove unsupported commonest-turn superlative. It need not join beta strands.

records.identity_decision: Retain umbrella for recurring arrangements of a small number of secondary elements; requires subtype-specific topology criteria.
gaps: Curator synthesis of inspected motif classes, not a quotation. Do not assert a universal fixed size or independent-folding rule. Classification requires a specified subtype rule; umbrella has no single topology matcher.

records.identity_decision: Retain broad recurring structural-element class; need not form an independently stable globular unit, rather than prohibiting stability.
gaps: Repair does-not-form to need-not-form. Remove whole-enum and peptide-helix equivalence xrefs; retain source attribution separately.

records.identity_decision: Preserve DSSP hydrogen-bonded T-state identity and ss_string T; not a universal parent for geometrically defined turns.
gaps: Preserve the original DSSP-state identity. This class is not the universal parent of geometrically defined beta turns; source SO:0001128 has the same hydrogen-bond tension and should not be inserted as an exact equivalent.

records.identity_decision: Retain functional subtype of TUNNEL only where a passage is supported as substrate-entry/product-exit route.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: A computed route becomes an access tunnel only with evidence connecting it to substrate/product transport. CAVER {input} is a PDB-file directory; config.txt requires a starting point and stated probe/shell/clustering parameters. Dynamics, gating and ligand chemistry can invalidate a path suggested by one static model.

records.identity_decision: Retain enclosed solvent-disconnected void under a stated model/probe; do not equate exposed active-site cavity wording with this class.
gaps: Cavity assignment depends on atomic radii, solvent-probe radius and the coordinate model. Check connectivity in the biological assembly; fpocket alone is not a complete enclosed-void detector.

records.identity_decision: Retain surface depression between elements/domains; no verified universal cutoff establishing equivalence to GROOVE.
gaps: A surface-topography result needs explicit shape, connectivity and assembly review before assigning this label. No universal length/width cutoff distinguishing clefts from grooves was established in this audit; do not infer binding from shape.

records.identity_decision: Retain elongated surface depression/channel; candidate topography does not establish binding.
gaps: A surface-topography result needs explicit shape, connectivity and assembly review before assigning this label. No universal length/width cutoff distinguishing clefts from grooves was established in this audit; do not infer binding from shape.

records.identity_decision: Retain solvent-accessible concavity as geometry; binding/catalysis/allostery need separate evidence.
gaps: Record the coordinate state, assembly and parameters. Predicted pockets require independent ligand or biochemical evidence for binding/catalysis; absent detection in one conformer does not establish absence from the protein ensemble.

records.identity_decision: Retain transmembrane conduction passage with ion discrimination; KcsA mechanism is a scoped example, not a universal channel architecture.

graphs.title: KcsA: selectivity-filter geometry supports selective potassium conduction

gaps: Pore geometry does not identify the permeating ion or establish selectivity. Require ion-specific functional evidence and an explicitly scoped structural model. The KcsA length, carbonyl arrangement and K/Na discrimination in PMID9525859 are an example, not a universal Na/Ca-channel architecture. CAVER input/configuration requirements are as documented in its manual.

records.identity_decision: Retain internal-to-exterior or region-connecting passage; geometry does not by itself demonstrate molecular transit.
gaps: CAVER {input} is a directory of PDB files. Run from its installed directory with lib, bin and caver.jar available; config.txt must define a starting point and probe/shell/clustering parameters. Candidate geometry does not prove molecular transport.

records.identity_decision: Retain positive modulation of specified activity/affinity under stated conditions; no universal R-state requirement.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: A pocket score cannot assign positive modulation. Measure the direction of the relevant activity or affinity change under stated ligand/assay conditions; an R-state model is not a universal requirement.

records.identity_decision: Retain negative modulation of specified activity/affinity; noncompetitive kinetic behavior is not definitional.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: A pocket score cannot assign negative modulation or a noncompetitive kinetic mechanism. Establish site-distinct inhibition and its assay-dependent effect experimentally.

records.identity_decision: Retain effector engagement at a distinct coupled site; an allosteric pocket is a narrower case and rigid conformational movement is not mandatory.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: fpocket screens concavities; establish effector binding and a coupled functional change separately. Sites need not form a pocket or follow a rigid conformational transition.

records.identity_decision: Retain covalent effector attachment with coupled remote functional change; KRAS(G12C) is study-scoped and not generic cysteine-only identity.

graphs.title: KRAS(G12C): covalent inhibitor binding changes nucleotide preference and Raf interaction

gaps: Pocket detection does not establish residue reactivity, covalent attachment or allosteric function. Verify the adduct/site and a coupled functional effect; the cited KRAS study is specific to mutant G12C.

records.identity_decision: Retain allosteric POCKET subtype conditional on reference conformation; bare cryptic binding pocket is broader and geometry alone does not prove allostery.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: Crypticity is relative to explicit conformations. Compare apo/ligand-bound states or an adequately sampled ensemble, and establish allosteric function independently; one static pocket call is insufficient.

records.identity_decision: Retain allosteric site at a subunit interface; inter-subunit allosteric pocket is NARROW_SYNONYM, not exact.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: Use the biological oligomer and identify which chains form the site. Predicted interface cavities do not demonstrate effector binding or causal coupling; homodimer mechanisms are not universal for all oligomers.

records.identity_decision: Retain selective noncovalent polypeptide-partner site; SO:0000410 retained, obsolete generic SO:0001091 removed; crystal contacts alone are insufficient.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: A structural contact requires biological-assembly and partner-context checks to distinguish binding from crystal packing. Contact geometry or a homologous interface predicts a candidate; affinity, specificity and oligomerization require separate evidence.

records.identity_decision: Retain direct or essential indirect catalytic contribution; proximity or substrate binding alone does not define catalytic identity.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: Structural proximity or substrate binding alone does not establish a catalytic role. Evaluate mechanistic literature and residue perturbation with folding/binding controls; transfer from characterized homologs requires conserved catalytic residues and compatible mechanism. No complete local transfer recipe was verified.

records.identity_decision: Retain local coordinating donor-atom arrangement; do not equate metal observation with physiological function, folding or catalysis.
records.graph_status: unsupported_generic_causal_graph_removed; no replacement universal mechanism asserted
gaps: Verify metal identity, occupancy, donor atoms, geometry and experimental context. A modeled metal or plausible coordination site does not establish physiological binding, folding effects or catalysis; distinguish the coordinating shell from larger comparison templates. No validated executable metal-site detector was established here.

castp_groove.purpose: CASTp provides topography for subsequent shape/connectivity review; not a verified general groove classifier and no CLI supplied.

unresolved.detail: No supported native reservation route established and no new IDs reserved. Existing-ID enrichment proceeded. Beta-arch remains a candidate requiring source identity, supported reservation and concurrent-owner coordination.

Documented algorithms and recipes were not executed. HTH is a sequence screen; Greek-key uses manual connectivity review; CASTp cleft/groove is topography support; allostery requires functional evidence; M-CSA/MetalPDB lack verified complete local recipes. Umbrellas have no single matcher.

No qualified occurrences. Generic internal structural IDs lack a supported source-specific producer/contract; native SIFTS/source providers require acquisition receipts and complete release-matched residue mapping. Representative PDB references do not bypass these gates.
prerequisites: Coordinate with the current owners of grounding/qualification code before any implementation; root is refreshing remote PR state.
A source-specific, receipt-bound producer must select exact asserted motif/site residues and exact PDB revision/chain/construct; do not synthesize a generic source row by hand.

A supported source contract must replay complete residue-level SIFTS mapping against a release-matched UniProt ProteinReference, including insertion codes, missing residues, amino-acid identities and all trait-defining positions.
Candidate generation and source-aware content validation must assert the exact internal trait identity without equating domains, folds, motifs, geometry and function.
Persist immutable resolved rows/resolution digests, source-stratified scientific review and explicit decision ledgers before any separately authorized promotion.
Promotion must install matching evidence/bindings and pass require-qualified semantic validation, guarded-writer and registry-integrity gates.
